capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-transaction address enrichment of saved older Savills catalogue rows
source_note: The official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data report builder was run across all five explicitly residential, sold, addressless appearances in the already banked first-page Savills commercial catalogue grids from 2005-2009. Three unique compatible exact-price matches were retained. The Nottingham vacant flat has one exact-price flat/maisonette leasehold transaction in Nottingham within 120 days. The two Merstham vacant freehold house lots have distinct exact prices mapping to the only compatible freehold Merstham transactions, adjoining Flat 2 and Flat 1 at School House, with the same completion date 37 days after auction. The Harrogate lot returned two compatible freehold houses and was left unchanged; the Ruislip lot returned no compatible exact-price freehold transaction. Original Savills evidence and every separate auction appearance remain preserved.
